attBesluta.text: I just bought this 10' x 10' wresting mat for my sons birthday. This mat is great quality, connects easily with the integrated velcro strip and stows away nicely.

These mats are phenomenal. Quality is extremely good, the Velcro and design matches up perfectly. One of the best purchases when it comes to home martial arts mats out there. Also the best price for what you get.
Bra matta för priset. Nästan lika bra (80-90%) som dyrare ju-jiutsu mattor. Väldigt praktiskt med kardborrband som håller ihop de två delarna. Perfekt för hemmaträning!
Super zufrieden, schnelle unkomplizierte Lieferung trotz Sperrgut.
Perfect wrestling mat for indoors. Good padding and rolls up for storage.
Foam wrestling mats offer a good balance of softness and firmness, providing excellent protection and ensuring safe training.
We are using these as wall pads at our gym. They are good, comparable quality to more known brands
Really happy with this mat - it fits our space perfectly and had only a slight "new car" smell for the first day. It's just perfect for stretching and yoga!
In verità l'ho acquistato un anno fa circa e un mese fa, l'ho messo nel garage della casa nuova, sono contento, parcheggio l'auto su tranquillamente

We hebben deze mat eigenlijk gebruikt om een parketvloer te beschermen tijdens een feestje. Deze mat verschoof niet, was perfect waterdicht, zacht aan de bovenkant en gemakkelijk op maat te snijden, exact wat we nodig hadden! Na een hele avond dansen pluist de mat op sommige plaatsen een beetje op, maar dit is gemakkelijk met de hand te verwijderen.
Was perfect to use for protecting my shed floor when parking the riding lawn mower.

The second mat I bought, the review from first mat Outstanding mat, stays planted firm to floor. I use it in my barn with a garage type floor finish. I have my 60hp Kabota tractor parked on it. Does not wrinkle and is very durable. I like it so much I bought another one to cover the entire entrance way into the barn.

Die Matte ist top, gefällt mir sehr gut. Es gibt einen Kritikpunkt: Die Falten in der Matte nach dem Auspacken. Trotz größter Anstrengungen die Falten und Wellen rauszubekommen, sind sie bis heute noch drin. Halb so wild, weil es eine Garage ist. Trotzdem eine klare Kaufempfehlung meinerseits!
The package was delivered very quickly, the product was a little lower quality then I was expecting. Over all, I am happy with my purchase.
